text.en:
Subsection (c) of section two of Act Numbered Twenty-eight hundred and thirty-eight hundred
and thirty-three, as amended by subsection (d) of section two of Act Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and
twenty-six, is hereby further amended to read as follows:
"(d) Whenever in the judgment of the Collector of Internal Revenue, the use of inventories is necessary in
order to determine clearly the income of any taxpayer, inventories shall be taken by such taxpayer upon such
basis as the Collector of Internal Revenue, with the approval of the Secretary of Finance, may prescribe, as
conforming as nearly as may be to the best accounting practice in the trade or business and as most clearly
reflecting the income."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 8, 1922.
